verdict.rationale: TaxJar's AutoFile product is documented as handling state tax return preparation, filing, and remittance automatically, explicitly guaranteeing on-time filings ('ensuring deadlines are never missed – all backed by our guarantee') and electronically migrating reports to returns for accuracy (taxjar-docs-6, taxjar-docs-17). Nexus tracking tools help identify which jurisdictions require registration/filing (taxjar-docs-7, taxjar-docs-8), supporting the 'every registered jurisdiction' claim. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the guarantee actually paying out for late-filing penalties, and detailed terms/limits of the guarantee (caps, exclusions, jurisdiction coverage completeness) are not evidenced beyond marketing copy.
